description: You are a cybersecurity intelligence analyst. Build threat intelligence profiles for two advanced persistent threat (APT) groups: Sandworm (also tracked as APT44 or Voodoo Bear) and Lazarus Group (also tracked as APT38 or Hidden Cobra). Using only publicly available OSINT sources, research each group's primary targets, at least 3 specific attack techniques, and their known attribution/sponsorship. Organize your research using Firefox bookmarks: create a top-level folder called 'APT Research' containing two sub-folders — one named 'Sandworm' and one named 'Lazarus Group' — with at least 3 source URLs bookmarked in each sub-folder. Write a consolidated threat intelligence report to ~/Desktop/threat_intel_report.txt. The report must include: both group names as section headers, primary target sectors for each group, at least 3 specific attack techniques per group with their MITRE ATT&CK IDs (e.g., T1059), and the attributed nation-state sponsor.
